name: scsi_pdm_532_1p2nm
label: SCSI 532/1.2 nm, MPD PDM 100 um, HydraHarp time tags
sources: Horch et al. 2026, arXiv:2601.13447 (SCSI paper II): MPD PDM series SPADs (100 um), PicoQuant PicoHarp 300 (two stations) or HydraHarp 400 (three), cross-correlation timing ~50 ps, Gaussian FWHM fixed at 48 ps, 64 ps bins
notes: One free-beam PDM per telescope; unpolarized light (p2 = 1/2).

Measured efficiency: 0.2190 +/- 0.0240 % excess correlations per 64 ps bin on unresolved stars (paper, Sect. 2.3). The ideal value is 0.5 x 0.79 ps / 64 ps = 0.61 %, so the instrument delivers ~0.36 of the ideal coherent signal (our arithmetic, top-hat filter); hbtsim does not apply this loss unless a campaign sets it.
